objectives: Use Hardware-Control Functions accurately in Arduino C++ sketches.
Predict exact pin or Serial behavior on hardware.
Avoid common beginner pitfalls with this core API.
conceptExplanation: Wrap low-level digitalWrite and analogWrite calls inside clear hardware-control functions like setMotorSpeed() or setTrafficLights().
Understanding how this core Arduino function interacts with hardware registers and timing lets you write responsive, bug-free robotics sketches instead of guessing.
lessons.analogy: Think of Hardware-Control Functions as one of the core instrument controls in your robotics cockpit — simple to call, powerful when combined cleanly.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using delay() when simultaneous button responsiveness is needed
